name: Frame Match Character
summary: Upload a frame and your reference character, get copy-ready JSON text-to-image prompts that recreate the same shot, pose, style and composition with your character swapped in.
use_when: The user wants to recreate a screenshot, movie still or viral frame with their own character, swap the subject of an image while keeping the camera, pose and lighting, or turn a stylized frame (anime, claymation, cartoon, 3D) into a matching or photorealistic prompt.
produces: Separate copy-ready JSON prompt blocks with full frame analysis: close match + creative variant for photoreal frames, or original-style close match, original-style variant and a photorealistic adaptation for stylized frames. Text and logos removed, character locked across frames.
